title: Dignity of mudwork
news: Young helpers in Kangra refused mudwork as 'dirty' and lowly, while cement work seemed modern and respectable; traditional masons are vanishing.
link: When society labels some work as low, it loses the skills and wisdom in it. Restoring dignity to traditional crafts, through pay, training and recognition, is both ethical and practical.
question: How do social attitudes towards certain kinds of work affect sustainable development? Discuss with examples.

title: Governance on paper, silence in practice
news: 53 of India's top 100 listed companies did not disclose whistleblower complaints in their FY26 annual reports.
syllabus: Ethics in business; Corporate governance; Probity; Transparency and accountability
link: Integrity in an organisation is tested by how it treats those who raise uncomfortable truths; a whistleblower system that is hidden or ignored is compliance without conscience.
question: "An organisation that silences its whistleblowers silences its own conscience." Discuss.

title: Cheap clothes, costly lives
news: Bangladesh's garment workers, who supply global brands such as H&M, Zara, Walmart and Primark, protested for a minimum monthly wage of 30,000 taka against the current 12,500 taka; 679 factories halted production and the government formed a wage board.
syllabus: Work culture; Ethics in business and corporate governance; Exploitation of labour; Dignity of work
link: Low wages in global supply chains shift the cost of cheap goods onto workers; ethical corporate governance means brands and suppliers share responsibility for a living wage, not just a legal minimum.
question: "Global brands cannot outsource their ethical responsibility along with their production." Discuss with reference to workers' wages in supply chains.

src: IE p. 13 (Idea Exchange: Sjoerd Marijne & Savita Punia)
title: A team that owns its vision
news: After two poor years, the women's hockey team asked for coach Sjoerd Marijne's return; he rebuilt cohesion through shared ownership, and the team won Asian Games gold and an Olympic berth.
syllabus: Leadership; Team building and motivation; Emotional intelligence; Work culture
link: Leadership that shares the vision, invites players to speak up and lets them meet without the coach builds ownership; authority grows when it is shared.
question: "A leader's vision succeeds only when the team owns it." Discuss with examples from public service.
